amendments.text:
(a) The

factor of safety in bearing at bolted or pinned joints shall be suitably increased to provide for the following conditions: (1) Relative motion in operation (control surface and system joints are covered in §§ 3.327-3.347). (2) Joints with clearance (free fit) subject to pounding or vibration. (b) Bearing factors need not be applied when covered by other special factors.
